title: Bosun Realm 30: The Glass Contract v1
description: Machine-readable delta schema contract for The Glass (Realm 30), extending Archetype Dual-Track Telemetry and Universal Meta-Envelope with realm-specific payload attributes.

realm.description: Canonical realm identifier for The Glass.

station_id.description: Meteorological weather station or barometer sensor identifier.

tide_gauge_urn.description: URN of the coastal tide gauge or hydrologic sensor.

telemetry_parquet_ref.description: Path or CAS reference to columnar weather telemetry dataset.
